column1: # Columns: name fixture
# #1070 flip-path parity manifest. Each fixture is executed through the public
# `run` flip path (KIZU_SELFHOST_RUN=1 -> run_file_cli + std::kizu::parser AST ->
# run-codegen tape -> native artifact) and compared against the Go interpreter
# baseline (default `run` = interp.runFile). Only fixtures that pass on BOTH paths
# are admitted; shapes the Go baseline rejects are out of #1070 scope.
# The first two fixtures are the #1070 PR-1 read-borrow regression (&[]u8 / &i64
# params reached by borrow-expression calls); flip_slice_index is the #1070 PR-2
# element-index regression (b[i] on a []u8); flip_slice_len is the #1070
# std::mem::len(s) regression (length of a str literal / []u8 slice);
# flip_slice_range is the #1070 PR-2b range-slice regression (b[i..j] on a []u8,
# const and variable bounds); flip_slice_open_range is the #1070 open-ended
# range-slice regression (b[i..] synthesizes SLICE_LEN as the end, b[..j]
# synthesizes CONST_INT 0 as the start; const and variable bounds, with a closed
# b[i..j] alongside to confirm the closed path is unchanged); flip_array_set is
# the #1070 ARRAY_SET regression
# (xs.set(i, v) on an Array<i64> with const and variable index/value);
# flip_array_pop is the #1070 ARRAY_POP regression (multiple pop values plus
# len-after-pop); flip_deref_read is the #1070 read-deref regression (`expr.*` on
# &i64 / &[]u8 borrow params, the identity dual of the read borrow `&expr`);
# flip_array_at_deref is the #1070 read-use Array.at regression (`let r = try
# xs.at(i); ... r.*`, where the read borrow + identity deref lowers like
# Array.get, const and variable index plus arithmetic on the read values);
# flip_array_capacity / flip_string_capacity are the #1070 CAP read regressions
# (STORAGE_CAPACITY opcode 131); flip_string_truncate is the #1070 String.truncate
# mutation regression (STRING_TRUNCATE opcode 132); flip_std_mem is the #1070
# std::mem helper regression (byte_at reuses SLICE_INDEX, slice reuses SLICE_RANGE,
# starts_with is MEM_STARTS_WITH opcode 133, trim_ascii is MEM_TRIM_ASCII opcode
# 134); flip_map_enum is the #1070 Map<[]u8, Enum> regression;
# flip_path_components is the #1070 std::path basename/dirname/extension regression
# (PATH_BASENAME opcode 135, PATH_DIRNAME opcode 136, PATH_EXTENSION opcode 137,
# pure byte-slice scans with the empty/root/trailing-slash/no-extension edges);
# the rest lock a supported subset so the baseline cannot silently drift.
